siteContent.headline: Websites that make an unforgettable first impression.
siteContent.subcopy: We design and build bespoke, ultra-fast websites for ambitious businesses. No bloated templates — just pure craftsmanship, clean code, and relentless attention to detail.
siteContent.aboutLead: We are an independent web design & development studio. We don't use confusing jargon or bloated templates. We craft fast, clear websites that turn visitors into paying customers.
siteContent.guarantee: Honest communication, clear timelines, and dedicated care.

projects.title: Objects for Living — Curated Store
projects.desc: An artisan lifestyle brand selling handcrafted ceramic and wooden objects. Features smooth 3D product previews and a seamless checkout experience.

projects.title: Form & Space — Architecture Studio
projects.desc: A clean, editorial portfolio for a boutique architecture practice. Full-bleed gallery imagery, fluid mobile transitions, and an interactive spatial project index.

projects.title: Pulse Analytics — Business Dashboard
projects.desc: A clear, uncluttered dashboard for founders to monitor their core metrics. Fast data rendering, accessible contrast, and zero confusing clutter.

projects.title: Flour & Stone — Artisanal Bakery
projects.desc: A warm, inviting website for an artisan sourdough bakery. Includes online pre-orders, daily seasonal menus, and a direct inquiry form for private catering events.

services.title: Web Design & Art Direction
services.desc: Custom designs tailored specifically to your brand. Clean typography, generous whitespace, and intuitive navigation that your customers will love using.

services.title: Frontend & Full-Stack Development
services.desc: Hand-coded websites built from scratch. Lightning-fast load times, zero unnecessary plugins, and clean code that is easy to maintain and grow over time.

services.title: E-Commerce & Digital Stores
services.desc: High-converting online shops built for smooth browsing and frictionless checkout. Designed to showcase your products beautifully on every device.

services.title: Speed Optimization & Core Vitals
services.desc: Audit and transform slow, sluggish websites into fast, responsive experiences. Improved load times mean higher search rankings and happier visitors.

services.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
services.desc: Built-in technical SEO that helps search engines understand and rank your website. Clean structure, meta tags, and structured schema data.

services.title: Maintenance & Ongoing Support
services.desc: Reliable ongoing support so you never have to worry about your website going down. Fast updates, regular backups, and friendly assistance whenever you need it.
